high_level_description: A cinematic 1600x900 local relationship study featuring one ivy-covered pickup truck centered horizontally, with its front hood clearly visible and one brown cat perched directly atop the hood, all against a plain near-white background.

style_description.aesthetics: Clean, structural, illustrative clarity with botanical texture
style_description.photo: 16:9 still, front-three-quarter view of truck with centered hood focus

compositional_deconstruction.background: Plain near-white background filling entire canvas

elements.desc: truck hood — horizontal rectangular base in dark gray, covered with overlapping green ivy ovals
cat — upright feline silhouette in warm brown with white belly, centered precisely on top of hood
truck body — simplified pickup silhouette including cab, bed, and wheel wells in dark gray, partially overlaid with ivy
